nodes.description: Public function aggregate(Call[] memory calls) that loops over a caller-supplied array of Call structs and executes an arbitrary low-level call for each target/callData pair, returning block.number and the array of successful return payloads.
Public view helper returning the native ETH balance of an arbitrary address via addr.balance.
Public view helper returning blockhash(blockNumber) for a caller-supplied block number.
Public view helper returning blockhash(block.number - 1).
Public view helper that reads block.timestamp and returns it, making its result dependent on miner-controllable time.
Public view helper returning block.difficulty.
Public view helper returning block.gaslimit.
Public view helper returning block.coinbase, the address of the block producer.
block.timestamp, an externally controlled / miner-influenceable value read inside getCurrentBlockTimestamp.

Low-level external call calls[i].target.call(calls[i].callData) executed inside aggregate's loop; the caller fully controls both the target address and the calldata, and no state guard or reentrancy protection is applied.
Caller-supplied array of Call structs (target address plus callData blob) that parameterizes the entire aggregate loop.
Caller-supplied address whose ETH balance is queried in getEthBalance.
Caller-supplied block number argument of getBlockHash.
Local return variable blockNumber of aggregate, assigned from block.number.
Local dynamic bytes array of aggregate that accumulates the return payload of each successful external call.
Loop counter i in aggregate used to iterate over the caller-supplied calls array.
Boolean capturing whether the low-level external call for the current call entry succeeded.
Raw bytes returned by the low-level external call for the current call entry.
Local return variable balance of getEthBalance holding addr.balance.
Local return variable blockHash of getBlockHash holding blockhash(blockNumber).
Local return variable blockHash of getLastBlockHash holding blockhash(block.number - 1).
Local return variable timestamp of getCurrentBlockTimestamp holding block.timestamp.
Local return variable difficulty of getCurrentBlockDifficulty holding block.difficulty.
Local return variable gaslimit of getCurrentBlockGasLimit holding block.gaslimit.
Local return variable coinbase of getCurrentBlockCoinbase holding block.coinbase.

edges.reason: The caller-supplied calls array directly determines the target address and calldata of the low-level external call, giving the caller full control over which external code is invoked.
The loop counter i drives repeated execution of the low-level external call for every element of the caller-supplied calls array.
The low-level call can transfer control to arbitrary attacker-controlled code, which may call back into aggregate before the loop completes because no reentrancy guard exists.
The raw return bytes of the external call are conditionally written into the returnData array when success is true.
The success flag gates whether the external call result is stored into returnData.
calls.length sizes the returnData array, tying the caller-supplied input length to the output buffer.
aggregate writes block.number into its local return variable blockNumber.
block.timestamp is read and stored into the local timestamp variable, making the returned value miner-influenceable.
getCurrentBlockTimestamp consumes block.timestamp as its only source of value, creating a timestamp dependency in the contract interface.
The addr parameter is dereferenced via addr.balance and assigned to the local balance return variable.
getEthBalance returns the local balance computed from the caller-supplied addr parameter.
The param_blockNumber parameter is passed into blockhash() and assigned to the local blockHash return variable.
getBlockHash returns the blockHash value derived from the caller-supplied block number.
getLastBlockHash returns the local blockHash computed from blockhash(block.number - 1).
getCurrentBlockTimestamp returns the local timestamp that holds block.timestamp, propagating the timestamp dependency to callers.
getCurrentBlockDifficulty returns the local difficulty value read from block.difficulty.
getCurrentBlockGasLimit returns the local gaslimit value read from block.gaslimit.
getCurrentBlockCoinbase returns the local coinbase value read from block.coinbase.

normalization_plan.reason: The calls parameter is consumed only inside aggregate and directly parameterizes the unsafe low-level call, so it can be normalized into the aggregate function node.
The addr parameter exists solely to compute addr.balance inside getEthBalance and carries no independent semantic weight.
The block number parameter is used only as the blockhash() argument within getBlockHash.
Local return variable assigned from block.number inside aggregate; it has no meaning outside that function.
Local accumulator array populated inside the aggregate loop and returned directly by aggregate.
Loop counter that only controls the iteration of aggregate's external call loop.
Boolean local capturing the success of the low-level call inside aggregate; it is an implementation detail of that function.
Raw return bytes local produced by the low-level call inside aggregate and immediately copied into returnData.
Return variable of getEthBalance derived from the addr parameter; mergeable into the function node.
Return variable holding blockhash(param_blockNumber); it is entirely internal to getBlockHash.
Return variable holding blockhash(block.number - 1); it is entirely internal to getLastBlockHash.
Return variable holding block.timestamp in getCurrentBlockTimestamp; it is the direct carrier of the timestamp dependency.
Return variable holding block.difficulty inside getCurrentBlockDifficulty.
Return variable holding block.gaslimit inside getCurrentBlockGasLimit.
Return variable holding block.coinbase inside getCurrentBlockCoinbase.
